threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think the buses run on time – you’ll learn quickly they’re more of a suggestion than a schedule.
Heard some bloke on the 133 bragging about dodging fares for years, then the driver just laughed like it was a regular thing. Classic Brixton!

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I saw a toddler riding a kick scooter while their dad held a beer, I thought, 'Yep, this is home.'

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: You know you’re in Kreuzberg when you see a kebab shop doubling as an art gallery after 9 PM on Fridays. Only in Berlin, trust me.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s local when they instinctively know not to stand on the left side of the BART escalator during rush hour.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the 14 today at 16th and Mission. A lady offered her spare sandwich to a guy asleep at the back. He woke up, smiled, and said, 'Best wake-up call ever.'

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Most tourists think Gràcia is just about bars and squares, but they miss the tiny art studios tucked behind the main streets, full of local talent.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can always tell a newcomer by their bewilderment at the two-hour lunch break. They still look at their watches like it’s a 9 to 5 gig.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still wait for the 149 bus and look shocked when it’s late. Everyone’s already used to the chaos of the timetable.
Last night on the 133, I watched a couple argue about whether pineapple belongs on pizza. It got loud enough for the driver to turn around and smirk.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: Caught a guy on my block feeding stray cats while blasting old Klaus Kinski movies. That’s when it hit me—this place has a vibe you just can’t fake.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Every Saturday in Kreuzberg, the Turkish market transforms the canal into a vibrant bazaar; the scents of grilled köfte and spices are unreal!

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell who’s from here; they shrug off BART chaos while others panic at the train delays, like it's just Tuesday.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Just saw a guy serenade the 38 bus with a ukulele. Crowded but everyone stopped to listen, even the driver. Classic San Francisco moment.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is all about the fancy plazas; they miss the quiet corners where the old residents still sip coffee and gossip about the weather.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their struggle to figure out the difference between 'carrer' and 'via'. Watch them hesitate at street signs.
